messages:
emily_support: FYI customer reported AWS Marketplace credits from their accelerator partner aren't showing up in their account. Ticket: https://zendesk.redwood/tickets/4321. They say marketplace invoice shows credit but our billing shows no promo applied.
carla_billing: Thanks — can you paste the customer account id and the marketplace order id?
emily_support: customer provided: acct=acct-8241, aws_order=MW-98765. Quote from them: \"partner portal shows $5k credit applied on 2025-08-01 but redwood billing balance unchanged\".
josh_eng: Quick checks: first run a parity on marketplace entitlement mapping and internal credit ledger. Common causes: 1) entitlement not linked to account (region mismatch) 2) marketplace order still PENDING/ACTIVATION_REQUIRED 3) credit type is partner-specific token not auto-applied.
nina_partner_ops: @emily_support did they register via the accelerator activation link we provide? Some accelerator credits require a manual activation flow on our side.
emily_support: I asked — they said they clicked Activation in partner portal and have a confirmation email (screenshot attached in ticket).
carla_billing: I'll check ledger for acct-8241. One sec.
ops_bot: Billing job sync for acct-8241 ran at 2025-08-02T02:10Z, status: SUCCESS, applied_promos: 0.
carla_billing: Ledger shows no promo entries for MW-98765. Marketplace order exists but entitlement_id not present in our promo_claim table.
josh_eng: Ok can you dump entitlement details from the customer's marketplace order? Run:
```
aws marketplace-entitlement get-entitlement --product-code MW-98765 --identifier acct-8241
```
emily_support: Got result from customer (they pasted): `{"entitlementStatus":"FULFILLED","entitlementId":"ent-0a1b2c","region":"us-east-1"}`
nina_partner_ops: Region matches. Could be we never processed the partner activation webhook for this accelerator program. I see a known gap: some accelerator partners send a separate webhook with `partner_promo_id`, not the standard marketplace entitlement.
josh_eng: If partner promo id missing, our claim pipeline ignores the order. Check our webhook logs: `GET /hooks/partner/accelerator` for ent-0a1b2c.
carla_billing: Logs: 2025-08-01T02:12Z - received webhook for ent-0a1b2c, payload had `partnerPromoId: "ACC-RED-2025-01"`. Worker returned 422 with body: `{"error":"unknown_partner_promo"}`.
emily_support: So the partner promo id wasn't recognized? Customer expects standard marketplace credit. They were in the accelerator program though.
nina_partner_ops: That promo id corresponds to a new accelerator cohort we onboarded last month but forgot to add to the promo registry — my mistake.
josh_eng: Good find. Two action items: 1) add ACC-RED-2025-01 to promo registry and trigger backfill job for ent-0a1b2c; 2) re-run claim pipeline for acct-8241. Backfill command (internal):
```
POST /internal/billing/promos/backfill
Body: {"entitlement_id":"ent-0a1b2c","promo_id":"ACC-RED-2025-01","account_id":"acct-8241"}
```
carla_billing: I'll add the promo mapping, then queue backfill for the single account. ETA ~30m.
emily_support: I'll update customer: \"We've identified the issue — the accelerator promo wasn't in our registry. We are adding it and running a backfill; credits should appear within an hour. I'll ping when done.\" :thumbsup:
ops_bot: Backfill job queued (job-id j-9932).
carla_billing: Backfill completed successfully at 2025-08-02T03:05Z. Promo applied: $5,000. Billing ledger updated.
emily_support: Confirmed with customer — they now see the credit. Closing ticket. Customer asked for a postmortem item to ensure partner promo onboarding checklist includes registry step.
nina_partner_ops: I'll add to onboarding checklist and send a short runbook to partners to include the exact `partnerPromoId` format we expect.
josh_eng: Optional: add monitoring that flags webhooks returning 4xx for unknown_partner_promo so we surface to partner-ops faster.
emily_support: Great, thanks all. Marking resolved.
carla_billing: Note for ops: replicate fix to GCP/Azure partner flows — similar promo mapping exists there.
emily_support: Noted. Closing thread.
